observed_before_prediction.explicitly_not_observed: no CSLS result, no delta, no post-processed ranking of any kind

pre_declared_ranking_rule: predicted transductive delta R@1 ordered by excess_skew_N10 (observed minus random-null) descending; rule declared in writing before the statistics were computed
observation_recorded_before_prediction: hub concentration ordering (TBAPR > AERI > TAG-PEDES > ICFG > CUHK) does NOT follow gallery size (ICFG 19848 is weaker than TBAPR 3200). Cross-dataset comparison must therefore use hub statistics, not ng, as the explanatory axis; the within-dataset distractor-scale experiment is the clean test of the size->hub->gain chain.

anchor.reference: TAG-PEDES ViT-B/16(+HR-MoE) transductive CSLS delta R@1 reported in the paper, Section 4.5 (+1.13)
anchor.rule: datasets with excess_skew above anchor predicted delta >= anchor; below predicted delta < anchor

predictions.inductive: same ranking as transductive; magnitude roughly 40-60% of the transductive gain
predictions.within_dataset_distractor_scale: for every dataset, excess_skew_N10 and delta R@1 increase monotonically with D; all four slopes positive; CUHK slope smallest
predictions.aeri_mixed_gallery: mixed gallery (9745) shows higher hub concentration and larger delta than aerial-only (5525)
predictions.tbapr_dedup_sensitivity: unique-text and gallery-dedup variants reduce excess_skew and delta but do not change sign

falsification: any dataset predicted positive with identity-clustered 95% CI entirely below zero
rank correlation between predicted and observed ordering <= 0 across the four datasets
any dataset with a negative distractor-scale slope whose CI excludes zero
policy: all results reported regardless of agreement with these predictions; no amendment to Lock-A permitted from this point
